     <p class="text-center">You are free to create any postcard design, but we set specific requirements for the layout to help you ensure that everything is within the printable area. Check out our mailing templates, which will guide you with the address, postal markings and indicia placement on the postcard. If you need help with your postcard printing and mailing, feel free to contact us through our live chat box or call us at 1-888-888-4211.</p>
